title: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
abstract: arXiv:2610.01093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. translated_title: OrbitTAMP：将语言模型接地于航天器交会中的任务与运动规划
translated_abstract: 航天器交会与接近操作（RPO）目前通过一种高度依赖专家经验的流程来规划：工程师需要将高层操作意图转化为安全且动力学可行的轨迹，这成为了可规模化运营的瓶颈。基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体可以为这一过程提供直观的交互界面，但其输出本身并不扎根于轨道动力学、操作约束或可允许的航天器机动结构。为了在利用LLM语义推理能力的同时确保所生成计划的物理有效性，本文提出了一种面向航天器任务与运动规划（TAMP）的分层框架，将LLM的推理接地于可复用行为图和领域专用规划模块。在该框架内，预训练的LLM将自然语言指令映射为部分任务规范，随后由相关规划器解析其中未指定的决策……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出OrbitTAMP，一种分层航天器任务与运动规划框架，通过将大语言模型的语义推理接地于可复用行为图和领域专用规划模块，实现以自然语言指令驱动的航天器交会操作规划，同时保证生成轨迹的物理有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes OrbitTAMP, a hierarchical task-and-motion planning framework for spacecraft rendezvous that grounds pretrained LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules, enabling natural-language mission specification while guaranteeing physically valid, dynamically feasible trajectories.
